    StartersAunt May's egg bitesBaked egg muffins with cheddar, spring onion and hamHow to make it8 eggs100ml milk100g cheddar, grated3 spring onions, sliced100g leg ham, dicedWhisk the eggs with the milk, cheddar, spring onion and ham.Pour into a greased 12-hole muffin tin.Bake at 180°C until puffed and set.Serve warm.Midtown Science pepperoni pizza rollsPuff pastry rolls with pizza sauce, pepperoni and mozzarellaHow to make it2 sheets of puff pastry, thawed4 tbsp pizza sauce100g pepperoni, sliced150g mozzarella, grated1 tsp dried oregano1 egg, beaten250ml passataSpread the pastry with pizza sauce, leaving a 1cm border, and scatter with pepperoni, mozzarella and oregano.Roll each sheet up tightly.Chill, then cut into 2cm slices.Lay cut side up on lined trays, brush with egg and bake at 200°C until golden.Warm the passata and serve for dipping.Steamed edamame with sea saltRodrigo Guevara's badge. Keep it on.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.MainsCaptain Stacy's red wine brisketBrisket braised in red wine, stock and tomato paste, roast carrotsHow to make it1.5kg beef brisket3 onions, sliced250ml red wine500ml beef stock2 tbsp tomato paste6 carrotsBrown the brisket and soften the onions.Add the wine, stock and tomato paste.Braise covered at 160°C.Add the carrots and roast for the last 40 minutes.Slice the meat across the grain.Queens glazed meatloaf with mashDinner at home, with Ben on responsibilityHow to make itAs written, serves 4Beef and pork meatloaf with onion and herbs, brushed with a sticky tomato and brown sugar glaze, baked and sliced thick over buttery mash.Mix 500g beef mince, 300g pork mince, 1 grated onion, 60g breadcrumbs, 2 eggs, 1 tbsp Worcestershire sauce, parsley and salt.Press into a loaf tin.Mix 100ml tomato sauce with 2 tbsp brown sugar and 1 tsp mustard and spread on top.Bake at 180°C for 1 hour, then rest 10 minutes.Boil 1kg potatoes and mash with 60g butter and 100ml warm milk.Slice the meatloaf thick over the mash.SweetsGwen's black and white cookiesSoft vanilla cookies iced half and halfHow to make it120g butter, softened150g caster sugar2 eggs150ml milk1 tsp vanilla extract300g self-raising flour300g icing sugar2 tbsp cocoa4 tbsp waterBeat the butter and sugar, add the eggs, milk and vanilla, then the flour.Spoon 12 rounds onto trays and bake at 180°C.Cool the cookies.Mix the icing sugar with the water to a thick icing and stir the cocoa through half of it. Ice half of each cookie with the white icing and half with the chocolate icing.DrinksGwen's dark hot chocolate with marshmallowHot milk whisked with dark chocolate, cocoa and vanilla, marshmallows on topHow to make it1 L milk150g dark chocolate, chopped1 tbsp cocoa2 tbsp brown sugar1 tsp vanilla extract1/4 tsp salt12 large marshmallowsHeat the milk until steaming but not boiling.Off the heat, whisk in the chocolate, cocoa, sugar, vanilla and salt until smooth and frothy.Pour into mugs, top with marshmallows and toast with a blowtorch or under a hot grill.Iced jasmine green teaDr Connors takes it one-handed.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.
